- There are eight small 3x3 targets and three movable outline shapes: an X, a diamond and a horizontal line.

- The level ends when every target centre sits on the outline of some shape. Putting a shape's centre on a target does not count.

- Line at (27, 6): covers the two targets on row 6.
- X at (42, 24): covers (33, 33), (48, 30) and (51, 15).
- Diamond at (18, 30): covers (9, 27), (21, 21) and (21, 39).
